title: "2. Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves and the Log-Rank Test"
author: "Xukun Zhu"
date: "2026-10-13"
output: html_document

#2.1 Data preparation
```{r}
library(survival)

vets <- read.table("data/vets.dat",
                   header = FALSE)

names(vets) <- c("id", "st", "perf", "dd",
                 "age", "pth", "d")

# Extract cell type from id
vets$cell_code <- vets$id %% 10000

# Part (a): Binary variable
# 1 = Large, 0 = Other
vets$celltype1 <- ifelse(vets$cell_code == 1000, 1, 0)

# Part (b): Four-category variable
vets$celltype4 <- factor(
  vets$cell_code,
  levels = c(1000, 100, 10, 1),
  labels = c("Large", "Adeno", "Small", "Squamous")
)

```

#2.1.a
```{r}
# Kaplan-Meier estimates
km_a <- survfit(Surv(st, d) ~ celltype1, data = vets)

# KM plot
plot(km_a,
     col = c("blue", "red"),
     lty = 1:2,
     lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Survival Time (Days)",
     ylab = "Survival Probability",
     main = "KM Curves: Large vs Other")

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Other", "Large"),
       col = c("blue", "red"),
       lty = 1:2,
       lwd = 2,
       bty = "n")

# Log-rank test
logrank_a <- survdiff(Surv(st, d) ~ celltype1,
                      data = vets)

print(logrank_a)

# P-value
p_a <- pchisq(logrank_a$chisq,
              df = 1,
              lower.tail = FALSE)

print(p_a)
```

#2.1.b
```{r}
# Kaplan-Meier estimates
km_b <- survfit(Surv(st, d) ~ celltype4, data = vets)

# KM plot
plot(km_b,
     col = c("red", "blue", "green4", "purple"),
     lty = 1:4,
     lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Survival Time (Days)",
     ylab = "Survival Probability",
     main = "KM Curves by Cell Type")

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Large", "Adeno",
                  "Small", "Squamous"),
       col = c("red", "blue", "green4", "purple"),
       lty = 1:4,
       lwd = 2,
       bty = "n")

# Log-rank test
logrank_b <- survdiff(Surv(st, d) ~ celltype4,
                      data = vets)

print(logrank_b)

# P-value
p_b <- pchisq(logrank_b$chisq,
              df = 3,
              lower.tail = FALSE)

print(p_b)
```

#2.2.0 Data Preparation
```{r}
library(haven)
library(survival)
heroin <- read_dta("data/heroin.dta")
```

#2.2.1
```{r}
# Convert clinic to factor
heroin$clinic <- factor(
  heroin$clinic,
  levels = c(1, 2),
  labels = c("Clinic 1", "Clinic 2")
)

# Kaplan-Meier estimates
km_a <- survfit(
  Surv(time, status) ~ clinic,
  data = heroin
)

# Display KM estimates
summary(km_a)

# Plot KM curves
plot(
  km_a,
  col = c("blue", "red"),
  lty = c(1, 2),
  lwd = 2,
  xlab = "Time in Treatment (Days)",
  ylab = "Retention Probability",
  main = "Kaplan-Meier Curves by Clinic",
  mark.time = TRUE
)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("Clinic 1", "Clinic 2"),
  col = c("blue", "red"),
  lty = c(1, 2),
  lwd = 2,
  bty = "n"
)
```

#2.2.2
```{r}
# Log-rank test
logrank <- survdiff(
  Surv(time, status) ~ clinic,
  data = heroin
)

print(logrank)

# Calculate p-value
p_logrank <- pchisq(
  logrank$chisq,
  df = 1,
  lower.tail = FALSE
)

print(p_logrank)
```

```{r}
# Peto-Peto weighted log-rank test
wilcox_test <- survdiff(
  Surv(time, status) ~ clinic,
  data = heroin,
  rho = 1
)

print(wilcox_test)

p_wilcox <- pchisq(
  wilcox_test$chisq,
  df = 1,
  lower.tail = FALSE
)

print(p_wilcox)
```

#2.2.3
```{r}
# Summary of dose
summary(heroin$dose)

# Histogram
hist(
  heroin$dose,
  main = "Distribution of Methadone Dose",
  xlab = "Methadone Dose (mg/day)",
  col = "lightblue",
  border = "white"
)

# Calculate median
median_dose <- median(
  heroin$dose,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

print(median_dose)
```

```{r}
# Create two dose categories
heroin$dose_group <- ifelse(
  heroin$dose <= median_dose,
  "Low dose",
  "High dose"
)

heroin$dose_group <- factor(
  heroin$dose_group,
  levels = c("Low dose", "High dose")
)

# Check group sizes
table(heroin$dose_group)
```

```{r}
# Kaplan-Meier estimates
km_c <- survfit(
  Surv(time, status) ~ dose_group,
  data = heroin
)

# Plot KM curves
plot(
  km_c,
  col = c("red", "blue"),
  lty = c(1, 2),
  lwd = 2,
  xlab = "Time in Treatment (Days)",
  ylab = "Retention Probability",
  main = "Kaplan-Meier Curves by Methadone Dose",
  mark.time = TRUE
)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("Low dose", "High dose"),
  col = c("red", "blue"),
  lty = c(1, 2),
  lwd = 2,
  bty = "n"
)
```

```{r}
# Log-rank test for dose groups
logrank_c <- survdiff(
  Surv(time, status) ~ dose_group,
  data = heroin
)

print(logrank_c)

# Calculate p-value
p_c <- pchisq(
  logrank_c$chisq,
  df = 1,
  lower.tail = FALSE
)

cat("Log-rank p-value =", p_c, "\n")
```
